turns.sql:
WITH ranked_users AS (
    SELECT
        u.Id AS UserId,
        u.Reputation,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY u.Reputation) AS TierNum
    FROM users u
),
user_tiers AS (
    SELECT
        UserId,
        Reputation,
        CASE TierNum
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Novice'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Experienced'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Expert'
        END AS Tier
    FROM ranked_users
)
SELECT
    ut.Tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.Id) AS DistinctBadgesEarned,
    AVG(ut.Reputation) AS AverageReputation
FROM user_tiers ut
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = ut.UserId
GROUP BY ut.Tier
ORDER BY
    CASE ut.Tier
        WHEN 'Novice' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Experienced' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Expert' THEN 3
    END;

WITH UserBadgeSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        u.Id,
        u.Reputation,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.Id) as BadgeCount
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.Reputation
),
UserTiers AS (
    SELECT 
        Id,
        Reputation,
        BadgeCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN Reputation < 1000 THEN 'Novice'
            WHEN Reputation BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Experienced'
            ELSE 'Expert'
        END as Tier
    FROM UserBadgeSummary
)
SELECT 
    Tier,
    COUNT(*) as UserCount,
    SUM(BadgeCount) as TotalDistinctBadges,
    AVG(Reputation) as AverageReputation
FROM UserTiers
GROUP BY Tier
ORDER BY MIN(
    CASE 
        WHEN Tier = 'Novice' THEN 1
        WHEN Tier = 'Experienced' THEN 2
        WHEN Tier = 'Expert' THEN 3
    END
);

    COUNT(DISTINCT b.Id) AS DistinctBadgeCount,
